name: Glicínia
source:
"Wisteria symbolizes romanticism for the Greeks and Romans with the aim of preserving the love between the couple."

The story revolves around Luara, a young adult who has a very complete life, a best friend, a quiet house and a concert by her band in three days!

The only problem is the frightening visions and horrible feeling of being chased that torment her at all times.

Could it be that by meeting a new person and reviewing the concepts of friendships in her life, she can get rid of this curse?

[From [url=https://trihqa.itch.io/glicinia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“对于希腊人和罗马人来说，紫藤象征着浪漫主义，旨在保存夫妻之间的爱情。”

故事围绕着Luara展开，她是一个年轻的成年人，她拥有非常完整的生活，一个最好的朋友，一个安静的房子和三天内她的乐队的音乐会！

唯一的问题是可怕的景象和被追赶的可怕感觉时刻折磨着她。

难道通过认识一个新的人，重新审视人生中的友情观念，她就能摆脱这个魔咒吗？

[来自[url=https://trihqa.itch.io/glicinia]Itch.io[/url]]
